question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
WITH filtered_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID as target_uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
all_tas_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte ON pe.stable_id = pte.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
uniprot_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id, pte.pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte ON pe.stable_id = pte.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pathway_stable_id as pathway_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pte.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT pw.pathway_id, pv.name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN up.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprot_id FROM filtered_targets) THEN up.uniprot_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN up.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprot_id FROM filtered_targets) THEN up.uniprot_id END) as c
  FROM pathways pw
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pw.pathway_id = pv.stable_id
  LEFT JOIN uniprot_pathways up ON pw.pathway_id = up.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY pw.pathway_id, pv.name
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_targets ft WHERE ft.target_uniprot_id IN (SELECT uniprot_id FROM all_tas_uniprot)) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tas_uniprot) as total_universe
)
SELECT pc.pathway_id, pc.name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    t.total_universe * POW(SAFE_CAST(pc.a * (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST((t.total_targets - pc.a) AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(pc.c AS FLOAT64), 2),
    SAFE_CAST(pc.a + (t.total_targets - pc.a) AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST(pc.c + (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST(pc.a + pc.c AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST((t.total_targets - pc.a) + (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64)
  ), 4) as chi_squared,
  pc.a as targets_in_pathway,
  t.total_targets - pc.a as targets_outside_pathway,
  pc.c as non_targets_in_pathway,
  t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3
